shortDescription: Module for setup of Report Avi RESTful Object

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_deactivate_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Deactivate Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: avi_patch_path
options.description: Patch path to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_patch_value
options.description: Patch value to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: duration
options.description: Time taken to complete report generation in seconds. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Unit is sec. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: end_time
options.description: End time of the report generation. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: filename
options.description: Name of the report artifact on reports repository. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the report. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: node
options.description: Cluster member node on which the report is processed. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: obj_state
options.description: State of the report generation. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: pre_check
options.description: Pre-check details for the report generation. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: progress
options.description: Percentage of tasks completed. Allowed values are 0-100. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Unit is percent. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 0.

options.name: request
options.description: Request for the report generation. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: start_time
options.description: Start time of the report generation. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: tasks
options.description: List of tasks associated with the report generation. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tasks_completed
options.description: No. Of tasks completed. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: Tenant uuid of the report generation. It is a reference to an object of type tenant. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: total_tasks
options.description: Total no. Of tasks. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Uuid identifier for the report generation. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.
